heroHeadline: Spain Warns Against New Crossing Calls as Social Media Push Targets Ceuta and Melilla on Morocco's Election Day
heroSubtitle: Spain's embassy in Rabat launched a Sep 21 disinformation campaign after online calls circulated for a mass irregular crossing into Ceuta and Melilla on Sep 23, timed to Morocco's legislative elections, following a similar call for Sep 20 that produced no incident and Guardia Civil reinforcements already sent to Melilla.
